mapper.select: SELECT user_password_reset_id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, used_at, requested_at, request_count, create_user_id, create_program, created_at, update_user_id, update_program, updated_at FROM t_user_password_reset WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY user_password_reset_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_password_reset SET used_at = #{usedAt}, update_user_id = #{updateUserId}, update_program = #{updateProgram} WHERE user_password_reset_id = #{id} AND used_at IS NULL
